statements.subject: server
statements.description: A server SHOULD be prepared to receive requests on any IP address, port and transport combination that can be the result of a DNS lookup on a SIP or SIPS URI [4] that is handed out for the purposes of communicating with that server.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: It is also RECOMMENDED that a server listen for requests on the default SIP ports (5060 for TCP and UDP, 5061 for TLS over TCP) on all public interfaces.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: For any port and interface that a server listens on for UDP, it MUST listen on that same port and interface for TCP.
statements.post_cond: server.listening_tcp = true & server.tcp_port = server.udp_port & server.tcp_interface = server.udp_interface
actions: listen on same port and interface for TCP as for UDP

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When the server transport receives a request over any transport, it MUST examine the value of the "sent-by" parameter in the top Via header field value.
actions: examine sent-by parameter value in top Via header field

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the host portion of the "sent-by" parameter contains a domain name, or if it contains an IP address that differs from the packet source address, the server MUST add a "received" parameter to that Via header field value.
actions: add received parameter to top Via header field value

statements.subject: message
statements.description: This parameter MUST contain the source address from which the packet was received.
actions: set received parameter value to packet source IP address
